fact: The Cour des comptes' 2024 annual report says the Institut national de santé publique receives its data from health establishments and their epidemiology and preventive medicine services as forms filled in by hand, with no database shared between the institute, the establishments and the ministry, and that the institute has begun a three-year strategy with the ministry's information systems directorate and WHO support to digitise the information system on DHIS2, on which a group has been trained and the next 18 months are to go on installing the application and training staff in establishments.
title: التقرير السنوي 2024
